name: archboard_workhorse
description: Inspect and steer the one workhorse bound by the host to this coordinator; no caller selects a target.

tools.name: inspect_workhorse
tools.description: Read the linked workhorse identity, state, queue, and bounded recent progress without waiting.

tools.name: delegate_to_workhorse
tools.description: Delegate one sustained request and bounded realtime transcript context to the linked workhorse.

tools.name: manage_workhorse_queue
tools.description: Inspect or mutate the linked created-workhorse queue through the host's serialized queue policy.

tools.name: steer_workhorse
tools.description: Append one bounded instruction to the host-proven active workhorse turn; the host supplies expectedTurnId.
